name: Egg Curry
summary: Hard-boiled eggs and peas in a spiced onion-tomato gravy over rice. Two eggs per person.

ingredients.name: chili powder (or cayenne for more heat)

instructions: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool them in cold water and peel. Cut a few shallow slits in each egg so the gravy soaks in. Cook the rice: 300 g rice with 600 mL water, simmered covered for 15 minutes, then rested 5 minutes.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Cook the onions 10–12 minutes until deep golden.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the cumin, coriander, turmeric, and chili for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and 250 mL water. Simmer 8 minutes until thick, then add the peas and 1 tsp salt.
Nestle the eggs into the gravy and simmer 5 minutes, spooning it over them. Stir in the garam masala and serve over rice.

glutenFree.notes: Eggs, tomatoes, peas, rice, and spices are naturally gluten-free. Check the garam masala label for added flour.

budgetNotes: Eggs are the cheapest complete protein on the site at about $0.33 each.
Frying the peeled eggs for a minute in a little oil with a pinch of turmeric before adding them gives them a chewy skin. It's traditional but optional.
Use two onions, not one. The onion is what makes the gravy thick.
